functions.description: Parse base Ivanti log structure: timestamp, host, event code, message
Extract the first single-quoted username/entity from the message
Extract source IP (IPv4 or IPv6) following 'from' in the message
Extract assigned VPN IP address when a tunnel is established
Classify action, severity, and category based on event code and message content

add.name: action
add.value: message.includes('authentication successful') ? 'success' : message.includes('failed') ? 'failure' : message.includes('established') ? 'connect' : message.includes('terminated') ? 'disconnect' : (message.includes('blocked') || message.includes('denied')) ? 'blocked' : (message.includes('modified') || message.includes('saved') || message.includes('initiated')) ? 'admin_action' : 'info'

add.name: category
add.value: event_code.match(/^AUT/) ? 'authentication' : event_code.match(/^VPN/) ? 'vpn' : event_code.match(/^SEC/) ? 'security' : event_code.match(/^SYS/) ? 'system' : event_code.match(/^ADM/) ? 'administration' : event_code.match(/^NHC/) ? 'host_checker' : 'other'
